title: Analyst Memorandum — Measuring a Guarantee Shortfall, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Measuring a Guarantee Shortfall

Memorandum of the analyst group on the shortfall a true-up is taken to have left on a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions. The measure turns on how often the tier trues measured savings up.

## Rule

- Where the tier trues measured savings up once a year, the measured shortfall is the savings guaranteed less the savings verified on the latest verification standing on the subscription, and never less than nothing.
- Where the tier trues measured savings up more often than once a year, it is the savings guaranteed less the savings verified, totalled over the verifications of the twelve months ending on the day of the payment, and never less than nothing.
- Where the tier trues no measured savings up at all, it is the savings guaranteed less the savings verified, totalled over every verification standing on the subscription.

## Table

| True-up frequency fixed for the tier | Verifications the figures are drawn from |
|---|---|
| annual | the latest verification standing on the subscription — the one signed off most recently |
| semiannual or quarterly | every verification signed off in the 12 months ending on the day of the payment, their guaranteed figures totalled and their verified figures totalled |
| none | every verification standing on the subscription, whenever signed off |

In each limb the savings verified are taken from the savings guaranteed, and the difference is held at nothing where it would fall below nothing.

## Cases (hypothetical)

*An annual tier* whose latest verification shows USD 18 000.00 guaranteed against USD 12 500.00 verified: a measured shortfall of USD 5 500.00, whatever earlier verifications show.

*A quarterly tier* with four verifications inside the twelve months totalling USD 24 000.00 guaranteed and USD 25 500.00 verified: the difference falls below nothing, so the measured shortfall is nothing.
